title: atm task hooks, hook registration, atm cron, doctor hook section
description:
## Goal
Every `atm task` subcommand can be replaced by an optional hook registered per team and phase; the daemon runs the module with one JSON request in a fixed environment under the module's `TIMEOUT_MS` and acts on one of three JSON replies (refuse, pass through, run these atm actions un-hooked). `atm cron start|end|list` keeps schedules in the daemon store and one daemon worker ticks them through the same hook contract. `atm doctor` calls each active module's `doctor()` for the caller's team. Authority: `docs/plans/phase-bk/design.md` over Rand's verbatim rulings on atm-core #1873 (2026-10-18); anchors `docs/plans/phase-bk/anchors.md`; requirements `docs/requirements.md` §11.5, §23, §24; ADR-068, ADR-069, ADR-061 D6 record of 2026-10-18.

## This Phase Does Not Close
The python module and its roles (phase bj); hooks on non-task commands;
cross-host hook execution; any replay of missed cron ticks.

Critical path 4 (bk-1, bk-2, bk-3 or bk-4, bk-5); width 2 (bk-3 with

when both are done (parallel-then-rebase, Rand 2026-10-12) and the lead
relinks it; bk-5 is cut from bk-4's layer. Earlier cuts: the first had the
CLI in wave 2 and a docs-only docs sprint; the second had the cron worker
in `atm-daemon-bootstrap` after the runner sprint; the third had one
contract sprint covering `atm-storage` and `atm-core`. Rand's ruling (PR
#1877, 2026-10-18: "I would expect atm cron to be in it's own crate w/
simple trait exposing it's features.") and ruthless-boundary-qa F001 moved
the worker into `atm-cron` behind the sealed core traits; the one contract
sprint grew past the plan gate's 24 000-byte reliable-review limit once the
three traits, the doubles, the stop condition and the protocol detail were
written at code level, so it is cut by crate into bk-1 (`atm-storage`,
`atm-storage-rusqlite`) and bk-2 (`atm-core`, `atm-error`), sequential
because the core traits take the storage row types. bk-5 composes the
crate, so it follows both runtime sprints.

## Decisions
D-1 fixed hook environment; D-2 no sha in atm, drift is `doctor()`'s; D-3 one
daemon-side runner, the daemon register route the only hook-name validator;
D-4 `atm-cron` crate behind `CronScheduler`, `cron` crate 0.17 UTC, no
missed-tick replay, one in-flight run per schedule, args in the stdin
request only; D-5 one active registration per (team, hook), any roster
member may register or start; D-6 `request` is the `RequestEnvelope` JSON,
an action is `{command, as, request}` and is valid only when `command` is a
task hook matching the request; D-7 contract types and the three sealed
traits in bk-1; D-8 in-memory active-hook snapshot, `Local` ingress, caller
from the request, one dispatch entry; D-9 mandatory stop condition (`--until`
or `--until-hook`, `cron.stop`), `atm cron end` the manual stop.

## Governed interfaces (ADR-061)

- HTTP API: six additive `RequestEnvelope` variants, `HTTP_API_VERSION`
  `1.12.0` → `1.13.0` in bk-1, with the D5 record line and both

- Hook stdin/stdout contract: `HOOK_SCHEMA_VERSION` independent of
  `HTTP_API_VERSION` (ADR-068 D8); one key-pinning test in bk-1.
- Herdr IPC: unchanged.
acceptance_criteria:
## Success Criteria
- `atm task close` on a team with an active `task.close` hook whose reply is `{"success": false, "message": "m"}` fails with message `m` and the task stays `active`; with `{"success": true}` the close equals an un-hooked close; with an `atm-action` list the listed commands run in order with hooks disabled (ANC-001, ANC-004..008).
- The hook module receives exactly `ATM_HOOK=1`, `ATM_TEAM`, `ATM_PHASE`, `PATH`, `HOME` and the registered cwd, and is killed at `TIMEOUT_MS` with `ATM_HOOK_TIMEOUT` (REQ-BK-D1, ANC-012).
- `atm hook register` refuses a module without `TIMEOUT_MS` and a second active phase for the same (team, hook); `atm hook disable --phase <x>` keeps the rows inactive (ANC-010, ANC-011, D-5).
- `atm cron start` rows survive a daemon restart, tick in UTC at the next future occurrence only, never replay missed ticks, never overlap, and record `last_run_at`/`last_outcome` (ANC-017..021, REQ-BK-D4A, REQ-BK-D4B).
- `atm doctor` from the registered team lists each active registration with its `doctor()` reply or typed error and never fails because of it; atm stores no module sha (ANC-015, ANC-016, D-2).
- `HTTP_API_VERSION` is `1.13.0`, `hook_registration` and `cron_schedule` are additive MINOR tables with the ADR-061 D3 proof test, the six codes are in `docs/atm-error-codes.md`, and `docs/user-documents/hooks.md` documents the module contract.

## Validation
- `cargo build --workspace`, `cargo test --workspace`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `just lint`, `just test` at the stack top.
